formula: It has been + period of time + since + clause It has been three years since the programme was introduced

formulas.formula: It has been + period of time + since + clause It has been three years since the programme was introduced

example: It has been three years since the programme was introduced.
exampleZh: 這項計劃推行至今已有三年。

examples.en: It has been three years since the programme was introduced.
examples.zh: 這項計劃推行至今已有三年。
examples.highlight: It has been three years since the programme was introduced.

rules.zh: 目標表達【It】是形式主語這裏的 it 並不代表某件物件。以【It】為例：只是用來建立「已經過了多久」的句型。
rules.en: It It has been three years since the programme was introduced.

rules.zh: 本課的目標結構固定使用 It has been + 時段 + since + 子句；不可把 has been 改成 is 或 was。
rules.en: It has been three years since the programme was introduced. It is three years since the programme was introduced. It was three years since the programme was introduced. It has been + period + since + clause

rules.zh: 後通常使用過去式正確：【It has been two years since the shop opened.】 以【Since】為例：後的子句指出過去的起點，因此通常使用 past simple。
rules.en: Since It has been two years since the shop opened. It has been six months since the machine was repaired. It has been three weeks since I last spoke to Chloe.

rules.zh: 被動語態也可以放在 since 子句中這項計劃推行至今已有三年。 這部機器完成維修至今已有六個月。 這項規則更改至今已有一年。
rules.en: It has been three years since the programme was introduced. It has been six months since the machine was repaired. It has been a year since the rule was changed.

rules.zh: 表示某人上一次做某事時，last 通常放在 since 子句的主要動詞前面，例如 since we last met 或 since the team last won。
rules.en: Last We last met two months ago. It has been two months since we last met. The team last won a match six months ago. It has been six months since the team last won a match. since we last met since he last called since the team last won

rules.zh: 不要在答案中同時使用 ago 錯誤：【It has been three years ago since the programme was introduced.】 正確：【It has been three years since the programme was introduced.】 詞語【Ago】通常出現在原句中：【The programme was introduced three years ago.】 改寫後，ago 會被 since 子句取代。
rules.en: It has been three years ago since the programme was introduced. It has been three years since the programme was introduced. The programme was introduced three years ago.

rules.zh: 單數時間單位前通常使用 a，例如 a year；複數時間則使用數字或數量詞，例如 three months 或 several decades。
rules.en: a day a week a month a year a decade It has been a year since the centre opened. two days six weeks three months five years several decades

rules.zh: 和 since 的功能不同我已有七年沒有回到母校。 我上次回到母校至今已有七年。 以【For】為例：後接一段時間；since 後接過去的起點或事件。相關但不屬於本課答案的形式以下句型與目標句型有關，但不作為本練習的標準答案：【Three years have passed since the programme was introduced.】 最後一句的縮寫形式在日常英語中很自然，但本練習統一要求學生完整寫出：【It has been】
rules.en: For For + period: I have not visited my old school for seven years. Since + starting event: It has been seven years since I last visited my old school. Related but Excluded Forms Three years have passed since the programme was introduced. The programme was introduced three years ago. It is three years since the programme was introduced. How long has it been since the programme was introduced? It’s been three years since the programme was introduced. It has been

benefits.zh: 清楚表示已經過了多久這個句型能把一段時間和一件過去的事情直接連接起來。這項計劃推行至今已有三年。 讀者可以立即知道：過去發生了甚麼事；那件事距離現在有多久。
benefits.en: It has been three years since the programme was introduced.

benefits.zh: 把兩項時間資料合併成一句不用分開寫：【The programme was introduced three years ago.】 可以更直接地寫成：【It has been three years since the programme was introduced.】 這個句型把過去的起點和直至現在的時間放在同一句中。
benefits.en: The programme was introduced three years ago. It is still running now. It has been three years since the programme was introduced.

benefits.zh: 可以改寫「多久沒有做某事」可以改寫為：【It has been seven years since I last visited my old school.】 這讓學生有另一種方式表達長時間沒有發生的事情，避免重複使用：【have not + past participle + for】
benefits.en: I have not visited my old school for seven years. It has been seven years since I last visited my old school. have not + past participle + for

benefits.zh: 適合表達周年、更新和進度這個句型很適合用來談論：周年紀念；計劃推行多久；上次檢查或維修的時間；上次見面或聯絡的時間；某項服務開始或停止了多久。學校正在慶祝，因為學校開校至今已有五十年。
benefits.en: The school is celebrating because it has been fifty years since it opened.

benefits.zh: 可以放入不同類型的句子目標句型不一定要放在句首。掌握這些句子框架後，學生可以在作文、報告、對話和簡報中更靈活地使用同一個核心句型。
benefits.en: It has been a year since the policy was introduced. According to the report, it has been a year since the policy was introduced. The council noted that it has been a year since the policy was introduced. Now that it has been a year since the policy was introduced, the council is reviewing it.
